'''2026 Retro Worlds Zach Stenerson LS Rendezvous Point''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Zach Stenerson]] at the [[2026 Retro World Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Zach Stenerson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2026 Retro World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:26RWC Stenerson LS Rendezvous Point.txt |Download]]
